# rauthy_scope (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Rauthy scope by name, for referring to scopes this configuration does not manage.

Requires the `Scopes:read` API key right.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Refer to a scope that was created outside this configuration.
data "rauthy_scope" "billing" {
  name = "read:billing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the scope to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attr_include_access` (Set of String) User attributes this scope adds to the access token.
- `attr_include_id` (Set of String) User attributes this scope adds to the ID token.
- `id` (String) Rauthy-assigned identifier of the scope.
